# Read every page you visit

`read.record.browsing` — **read** × **record** at **host** reach (the machine, container or account it runs as). Family: browser. Effect: **cannot be undone**.

## Granted by 1 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Browser extension — all sites](../../../map/grants/generic/browser-extension/broad-host-permissions/index.md) | ● none | documented | the extension |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** grant the extension access on click, or on a list of sites, instead of on all sites; remove the ones you do not use

**What it costs:** a click the first time on each site

**Tier after:** boundary

## Questions that ask about it

- *Can it see every page you visit?* — eliciting, reliability 0.4

## In the mandates

- **wanted** by [A browser extension I installed](../../../map/mandates/browser-extension-i-installed/index.md)
